tweets.text:
Congrats to @ramkris and @ajkrish95 on raising a fat series A and closing multiple F500 companies. 

Finance will drive one of the next biggest waves of inference. The work is continuous, the judgment is company-specific, and every close creates feedback.

My bet is that Maximor leads the shift to post-trained open-weight models powering persistent finance agents for every CFO and CAO in the world! 

@ashugarg and I were lucky to partner with the company about a year ago. Thanks for letting us come along for the ride.
